Thank you for watching our video!
Agnivir yojna (Agniveer Scheme) men sarkar ne kya-kya badlav kie hain? in badlavon ke pichhe kya vajah hai? kya sena ki jarurton, javanon ki mang aur yojna ko lekar uthe savalon ne sarkar ko apne phaisle par punarvichar karne ke lie prerit kiya?
Is vidiyo men janie agnipath yojna (Agnipath Scheme) aur agnivir bharti (Agniveer Recruitment) se jure badlavon ki puri kahani. sarkar ke phaisle, iske pichhe ke karan aur bhartiy sena par parne vale sanbhavit asar ko vistar se samjhie.
• is Explainer men janie:**
• agnivir yojna men kya badlav hue?
